description.tr: Kavrulmuş kahve çekirdeğinin ince öğütülmesiyle hazırlanan geleneksel kahve. Cezvede pişirilerek servis edilir; ikram ve kafe kullanımı için uygundur. Toptan fiyat, stok ve spec sheet için +90 342 238 11 11 · info@burcakbaharat.com.tr.
description.en: Traditional coffee made from finely ground roasted coffee beans. Brewed and served in a cezve (Turkish coffee pot); suitable for hospitality and café use. For wholesale pricing, stock, and spec sheet: +90 342 238 11 11 · info@burcakbaharat.com.tr.
description.es: Café tradicional preparado con granos de café tostados molidos finamente. Se sirve cocido en cezve; apto para atenciones a invitados y uso en cafeterías. Para precios al por mayor, existencias y spec sheet: +90 342 238 11 11 · info@burcakbaharat.com.tr.
description.fr: Café traditionnel préparé à partir de grains de café torréfiés finement moulus. Cuit dans un cezve avant d'être servi ; convient à l'accueil des invités et à un usage en café. Prix de gros, stock et spec sheet : +90 342 238 11 11 · info@burcakbaharat.com.tr.
description.de: Traditioneller Kaffee aus fein gemahlenen gerösteten Kaffeebohnen. Wird in der Cezve (türkisches Kaffeekännchen) gekocht und serviert; geeignet für Bewirtung und Café. Für Großhandelspreis, Lagerbestand und Spec Sheet: +90 342 238 11 11 · info@burcakbaharat.com.tr.

Product information

Wholesale and quotations

For pricing, stock, and technical information (spec sheet), you can call +90 342 238 11 11 or write to info@burcakbaharat.com.tr.
